title: Nintendo 3DS Game Card Teardown/How to Open
author: Mr. L

steps.title: Locate the Tab on the Game Card
lines: Find the tab on the left side of the cartridge.

steps.title: Pry open the Cartridge
lines: Use your fingernails to pop open the top from the bottom
BE CAREFUL WHILE DOING THIS. If you aren’t careful, the game case may crack and or not go back together.

steps.title: Pry around the rest of the Game Card with an Opening Tool
lines: Go around all parts of the cartridge and do not crack the plastic.

steps.title: Remove the top of the Cartridge
lines: Remove the top of the Game Card with your fingers.
